# Times Berwick

> Modern Australian steakhouse in Berwick, Melbourne. Multi-award winning restaurant with 15+ years of history, serving premium steaks, pasta, seafood, and curated dining experiences.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Times Berwick, featuring signature dishes, awards, and dining experiences.
- [Menu](/menu): A-la-carte menu including raw & cold, starters, skewers, mains, sides, and desserts.
- [Functions](/functions): Private dining and event packages for groups and celebrations.
- [What's On](/whats-on): Current promotions, including Chef's Table, Date Night, rewards, and weeknight offers.
- [Chef's Table](/chefs-table): Feed-me style shared dining experience with set menu options.
- [Rewards](/rewards): Loyalty programme details and member benefits.
- [Date Night](/date-night): $50 per person set menu and date night experience information.
- [Contact](/contact): Location, opening hours, phone, and booking enquiries.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photo collection of dishes from the kitchen.

## Optional

- [Mother's Day](/mothers-day): Seasonal Mother's Day dining menu and booking information. Available only when the promotion is active.
- [Father's Day](/fathers-day): Father's Day dining on Sunday 6 September with a reduced a-la-carte menu and gift cards. Available only when the promotion is active.
